boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten named Harvard Library work settings, spanning quiet carrels, open reading rooms, collaboration spaces, and media-oriented areas.

cards.title: Cabot Main Level
cards.subtitle: Cabot Science Library, Science Center
cards.notes: Use the open main level when you want a private desk or softer seating; lockers and technology-loan services are listed nearby.
cards.short_summary: An open Science Center library level with desks, seating, lockers, and technology support.
cards.evidence_claim: Harvard Library lists Cabot Main Level as an open space with couches or armchairs, lockers, private desks, and technology loan.
cards.access_notes: Cabot Science Library is open to Harvard ID holders; confirm current building hours before visiting.

cards.title: Cabot Lower Level
cards.subtitle: Cabot Science Library, Science Center
cards.notes: Head downstairs for an open setup with private desks and couches or armchairs; the library also lists café and technology-loan amenities.
cards.short_summary: A lower-level Cabot workspace combining individual desks with relaxed seating.
cards.evidence_claim: Harvard Library lists Cabot Lower Level as an open space with private desks, couches or armchairs, a café onsite, and technology loan.
cards.access_notes: Cabot Science Library is open to Harvard ID holders; confirm current building hours before visiting.

cards.title: Cabot L102 - Discovery Bar
cards.subtitle: Cabot Science Library, Science Center
cards.notes: Choose this main-level meeting and presentation space when a projector or digital display and standing desks fit the task at hand.
cards.short_summary: A Cabot meeting-and-presentation setting with display and standing-desk features.
cards.evidence_claim: Harvard Library lists Cabot L102 - Discovery Bar as a main-level meeting and presentation space with a projector or digital display and standing desks.
cards.access_notes: Cabot Science Library is open to Harvard ID holders; confirm current building hours and any room-use requirements before visiting.

cards.title: Lamont Donatelli Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Lamont Library, Harvard Yard
cards.notes: Set up at a table, carrel, or soft seat for silent study; outlet strips at the carrels support longer device-based sessions.
cards.short_summary: A light-filled Lamont room designed for silent work, with tables, carrels, outlets, and soft seating.
cards.evidence_claim: Harvard Library describes the Donatelli Reading Room as a light-filled silent-study space with study tables, carrels with outlet strips, and soft seating.
cards.access_notes: Lamont Library is open to Harvard students, faculty, and staff; verify current hours before making the trip.

cards.title: Lamont Ginsberg Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Lamont Library, Harvard Yard
cards.notes: Use the main-level reading room when you want an open workspace with private desks, couches or armchairs, and technology loan nearby.
cards.short_summary: A main-level Lamont reading room pairing individual desks with comfortable seating.
cards.evidence_claim: Harvard Library lists Lamont Ginsberg Reading Room as a main-level open space with couches or armchairs, private desks, café onsite, and technology loan.
cards.access_notes: Lamont Library is open to Harvard students, faculty, and staff; verify current hours before visiting.

cards.title: Lamont Level A
cards.subtitle: Lamont Library, Harvard Yard
cards.notes: Start here when your work mixes desk time with media production; Harvard lists private desks, media studios, café service, and tech loan.
cards.short_summary: A Lamont open space where private desks sit alongside media-studio resources.
cards.evidence_claim: Harvard Library lists Lamont Level A as an open space with private desks, media studios, technology loan, and a café onsite.
cards.access_notes: Lamont Library is open to Harvard students, faculty, and staff; verify current hours before visiting.

cards.title: Widener 210 - Loker Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Widener Library, Harvard Yard
cards.notes: Take the second-floor option when you need an open reading-room setting with charging and couches or armchairs for a change of posture.
cards.short_summary: A second-floor Widener reading room with charging and relaxed seating.
cards.evidence_claim: Harvard Library lists Widener 210 - Loker Reading Room as a second-floor open space with charging stations, couches or armchairs, and wheelchair accessibility.
cards.access_notes: Widener Library is open to Harvard ID holders, who may bring up to four guests; visiting researchers can apply for access.

cards.title: Widener 230 - Atkins Reference Room
cards.subtitle: Widener Library, Harvard Yard
cards.notes: Use this second-floor open space when a charging station and accessible room are useful; consult current Widener access before arrival.
cards.short_summary: A second-floor Widener open space with charging and accessibility features.
cards.evidence_claim: Harvard Library lists Widener 230 - Atkins Reference Room as a second-floor open space with charging stations and wheelchair accessibility.
cards.access_notes: Widener Library is open to Harvard ID holders, who may bring up to four guests; visiting researchers can apply for access.

cards.title: Widener West Stacks Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Widener Library, Harvard Yard
cards.notes: Look for the rotunda reading room if you want an open Widener setting with charging and couches or armchairs; check building access first.
cards.short_summary: A rotunda-based Widener open space with charging and lounge-style seating.
cards.evidence_claim: Harvard Library lists Widener West Stacks Reading Room as a rotunda open space with charging stations and couches or armchairs.
cards.access_notes: Widener Library is open to Harvard ID holders, who may bring up to four guests; visiting researchers can apply for access.

cards.title: Tozzer Study Carrels
cards.subtitle: Tozzer Library, 21 Divinity Avenue
cards.notes: Use a basement carrel for private-desk work, with printing, charging, couches or armchairs, and nearby study resources listed for the space.
cards.short_summary: Basement study carrels with private desks, charging, printing, and lounge seating.
cards.evidence_claim: Harvard Library lists Tozzer Study Carrels as basement study carrels with private desks, printers or scanners or copiers, charging stations, and couches or armchairs.
cards.access_notes: Tozzer Library is open to Harvard ID holders; non-Harvard users interested in general collections can apply for access.
